cues.title: 三个探头，为什么一起变？
cues.titleEn: Why do all three probes change?
cues.caption: 一个下降，两个上升：它们测的是什么？
cues.captionEn: One falls, two rise. What does each probe measure?
cues.zh: 光照后，同一瓶氯水里的三条读数都变了。液体的pH下降，氯离子浓度上升，上方气体中氧气的比例也上升。沿着探头找一找：两支在水里，一支在气体中。它们测的不是同一个量，为什么会一起变化？先跟着光，进入一个分子。
cues.en: After illumination, three readings from one chlorine-water sample change. Liquid pH falls, chloride concentration rises, and the oxygen fraction above the liquid rises. Follow the probes: two are in the liquid, one in the gas. They measure different quantities. What connects these changes? Follow the light into a molecule.

cues.title: 光吸收后，哪条键断开？
cues.caption: 盯住氧—氯键的两个电子。
cues.captionEn: Track the two electrons in the oxygen–chlorine bond.
cues.zh: 看这个被吸收的紫外光子。次氯酸的氧—氯键可以由此断开。盯住成键的两个电子：分开时，各有一个跟着自己的片段。氢仍连在氧上，形成羟基自由基；另一边是氯自由基。它们都是电中性的，还不是探头读到的氯离子。光先打开了一条反应通道。
cues.en: Watch this selected absorbed ultraviolet photon. It can open a channel that breaks the oxygen–chlorine bond. Track the two bonding electrons: one stays with each fragment as they separate. Hydrogen remains joined to oxygen, making a hydroxyl radical; the other fragment is a chlorine radical. Both are neutral. We have not yet made the chloride ion measured by the probe.

cues.title: 同一批原子，最后去了哪里？
cues.titleEn: Where do the same atoms end up?
cues.caption: 经过后续多步反应，再看净变化。
cues.captionEn: After further reactions, follow the net changes.
cues.zh: 断开这条键只是起点，并不是生成氧气的完整过程。现在把后续多步反应合成一张净变化账本。两份次氯酸减少，水中增加两份氢离子和两份氯离子；两个氧原子组成一份氧气。氢离子增多，对应pH降低；氯离子增多，对应另一支探头上升。再跟着同一对氧，越过液面，来到气体探头这一侧。
cues.en: Breaking that bond is a beginning, not the complete route to oxygen. Now combine subsequent reactions into a net account. Two hypochlorous acid units are consumed, adding two hydrogen ions and two chloride ions to the liquid; their oxygen atoms form one oxygen molecule. More hydrogen ions mean lower pH, while chloride concentration rises. Follow the same oxygen pair across the liquid surface to the gas probe’s side.

cues.title: 同一份变化，为什么读数增幅不同？
cues.titleEn: Why do the readings change by different amounts?
cues.caption: 先数物质的量，再看各自的刻度。
cues.captionEn: Count the amounts, then inspect each measurement scale.
cues.zh: 数一数：新增两份氯离子，对应一份氧气。这就是净反应给出的二比一关系。可别期待三条曲线长得一样。pH把氢离子浓度放到对数刻度上；氯离子探头读浓度；氧气探头读它占全部气体的比例。尤其是这个分母：原来有多少气体，也会改变最后的氧气读数。
cues.en: Count the products: two new chloride ions accompany one oxygen molecule. That is the net reaction’s two-to-one amount relation. But the three curves need not look alike. pH uses a logarithmic concentration scale, the chloride probe measures concentration, and the oxygen probe measures a fraction of all the gas. Notice that denominator: the amount of gas already there also affects the final reading.

cues.title: 氧气比例更小，就产得更少吗？
cues.titleEn: Does a smaller oxygen fraction mean less was made?
cues.caption: 同样产气，哪路读数会变？
cues.captionEn: With equal oxygen production, which reading changes?
cues.zh: 现在换两份独立样品：液体一样多，次氯酸净分解量也一样，只把B上方的气体体积加倍。先猜，哪路读数会变？两份新生成的氧气相同，B却有更多原有气体。混合后，B的氧气比例较小，液体的pH和氯离子浓度仍然相同。所以，看到比例较低，先问分母变了没有，再判断产量。
cues.en: Compare two separate samples with equal liquid volumes and equal net decomposition. Only B has twice the initial headspace. First predict: which reading changes? Both make the same amount of oxygen, but B starts with more gas. After mixing, B has the smaller oxygen fraction; liquid pH and chloride concentration remain equal. Before interpreting a lower fraction as lower production, check whether its denominator changed.

question.zh: 光怎样让三路读数一起变化？
question.en: How can light change all three readings?

lead.zh: 沿着同一批原子，从吸收光到净变化，再追到液相与气相探头。
lead.en: Follow the same atoms from absorbed light to net change and the liquid and gas probes.

principle.zh: 光可开启化学变化；教材净反应把HClO减少与H⁺、Cl⁻、O₂增加联系起来，不同探头读的是不同物理量。
principle.en: Light can initiate chemistry. The textbook net reaction links HOCl loss to H⁺, Cl⁻ and O₂ gains; different probes measure different quantities.

question.zh: 净分解量相同，气相体积加倍，哪路读数改变？
question.en: At equal net decomposition, which reading changes when headspace doubles?

explanation.zh: 该理想模型生成相同的O₂，但较大的气相有更多原有气体，O₂比例上升较少；液相体积和生成的H⁺、Cl⁻量相同，pH及氯离子浓度相同。
explanation.en: The ideal model generates the same O₂, but a larger headspace contains more initial gas, so its oxygen fraction rises less. Equal liquid volume and equal H⁺/Cl⁻ production leave liquid pH and chloride concentration equal.

title.en: Chlorine-water photolysis: from light to readings

description.zh: 跟随光吸收和同一批原子，解释三路探头，再用顶空变化检验比例与产量。
description.en: Follow absorbed light and the same atoms to explain three probes, then test whether a changed fraction means a changed yield.

translations.A与B独立样品的液体相同，新增氧气相同；比较不同初始气体体积: Independent A and B samples have equal liquid volumes and equal newly generated oxygen; compare different initial gas volumes
translations.教材记录只保留固定观察方向。254 nm紫外是单独选定的吸收解离事件，不代表教材: The textbook observations retain fixed directions. The selected 254 nm absorption/dissociation event is not the textbook source spectrum, an absorption spectrum, a quantum yield or a rate law. Only the two electrons of the selected O–Cl bond are tracked; H–O stays joined.
translations.初始自由基与后续净反应是两个描述层次。净原子路径合并中间步骤，H⁺表示水合的酸性: Initial radicals and the later net reaction are different descriptive levels. Atom paths combine intermediate steps; H⁺ stands for hydrated acidic hydrogen. Solvent structure and subsequent electron transfers are not expanded. The tracked oxygen enters the headspace account only after its whole drawing crosses the surface.
The example uses 100 mL liquid, initially 0.018 mol/L HOCl and 0.008 mol/L each of H⁺ and Cl⁻; initial gas is at 298.15 K and 1 atm with 18% O₂. Concentration approximates pH; dissolution, equilibria, competing reactions and transport are omitted. At the endpoint all generated O₂ is in the headspace. The axis is net extent, not the textbook 150-second record. Changing headspace compares separate samples; the dark model omits slow dark chemistry.

scientificBoundaries: No H2/Cl2 initiation or explosive-mixture apparatus is involved; textbook entry is chlorine-water photolysis.
UV photon is neutral/hatched and labelled invisible; do not render it as visible purple.
A photon being energetic enough is not proof it is absorbed or yields one lasting radical pair. No quantitative radical yields or lifetimes.
HO· and Cl· are radicals, not H+ and Cl−; the microscope scene and net-product scene are explicitly distinct.
No complete elementary O2 mechanism inferred from three endpoint sensors. Subsequent branching and solvent processes exist.
The illustrative acid/chloride values assume concentration-based pH and ignore speciation/activity/hydrolysis; all generated O2 in gas is an endpoint approximation.
Headspace controls compare independent samples, not unexplained deformation of the same sealed bottle.
Switching to a dark independent sample does not erase products in the lit sample or assert absolute absence of long-time dark chemistry.
No operating recipe, chlorine generation conditions, household UV treatment recommendation or exposure optimization.
